overview.match: Brett Morrow is a candidate for Santa Monica City Council
overview.text: Brett Morrow is a candidate for Santa Monica City Council and chief communications officer for the Los Angeles County Department of Public Health. His campaign says he has worked in communications and community advocacy for more than two decades. He previously served as a congressional staffer for Keith Ellison. He is a member of Santa Monica’s Housing and Human Services Commission. His candidate statement lists priorities of renter protections, affordable housing, lower costs, public safety, mental health and addiction services, support for workers and small businesses, and accountable government. In July 2026, he spoke in favor of a $495-per-parcel school tax for the Santa Monica-Malibu Unified School District, saying it would save teaching positions.
